These unilateral coercive measures violate the principles of sovereign equality and cooperation, interfere in the internal affairs of other countries, violate the purposes and principles of the Charter of the United Nations, and are contrary to multilateralism and international law. Fu said that despite repeated calls by the international community for the immediate lifting of unilateral coercive measures, these illegal measures continue to have serious consequences and even endanger the lives of the targeted countries and their people.
